# AI Engineering Operating Model Playbook

> An open, sourced playbook on converting AI capability into governed engineering
> value in mid-size engineering organisations: platform, context and knowledge,
> governance, measurement, readiness, sequencing and the business case.
> Written by Yaroslav Pavolotskyi. Version 1.0, August 2026. Licensed CC BY 4.0.

## Core content

- [The playbook](https://yspbob.github.io/AI-Playbook/AI_Engineering_Playbook.html):
  the full argument in twelve sections and two appendices. Covers the operating
  model thesis, platform architecture, the data and context harness, the
  interpretation layer, process and delivery, governance and controls, org and
  people, measurement, value capture, an eight-dimension readiness model, phased
  sequencing with gates, and a worked business case. Every claim is labelled by
  evidence type; market data is dated in place.
- [Twelve Decisions deck](https://yspbob.github.io/AI-Playbook/Twelve_Decisions.html):
  the executive companion. Twelve cross-discipline decisions that decide whether
  AI engineering pays, and five questions any executive can ask before an AI
  programme starts or scales. Also available as a PDF at
  https://yspbob.github.io/AI-Playbook/Twelve_Decisions.pdf
- [Business-case workbook](https://yspbob.github.io/AI-Playbook/AI_Business_Case_Model.xlsx):
  an illustrative, directional model to rebuild with organisation-specific
  inputs. Outputs are payroll-equivalent capacity values rather than cash or
  EBITDA; financial recognition depends on the chosen conversion route.
